coverage_target_boundary: Coverage validated here is for the BOUNDED ARBITRARY-RUNNING-MEAN target mubar_n = (1/n) sum_{i<=n} E[Z_i | F_{i-1}] of a synthetic stream. It does NOT establish the assumptions needed for a causal pair-orientation interpretation: pre-enrolled nonoverlapping arrival positions chosen without their outcomes, one fresh fair coin per pair logged and fsynced before either episode is dispatched, single exposure, no cross-pair interference, no dependence of a task's record on a later coin, an operator who does not act on coins, a fixed scheduling and resource policy, and the frozen outcome/missingness rule. A simulation assumes those; it cannot supply them.
